note: Both sets cover the Cooking thresholds thoroughly but are highly redundant; Set A additionally contains a clear misread (0 points for vaporized weight < 80 oz, when the figure gives 0 points only at ≤16 oz) and an unsupported 100-points claim whose quote is only the figure caption, plus an altered quote for the 5.000 lb reduced-points bound. Set B's errors are milder (a caption-only quote for the 0-point threshold, a garbled reconstructed quote, and the 0–100% range loosely bound to the dinner-party final score rather than the percentage integer scores). Set B also captures Dinner Party facts (two parties per team, 0–100% scoring) that Set A omits entirely, so B is the more complete and faithful set.
